build_s2tt_dataloader: build a speech-to-text dataloader from a TSV data file with audio root directory and target language args
strip_silence_from_audio: strip silence from the beginning and end of audio using SileroVAD silence remover
create_sound_file_info: create a SoundFileInfo dataclass instance with samplerate and path fields
count_lines_in_file: count the number of lines in a text file using wc -l
configure_dataloader_args: configure argparse arguments for the fairseq2_s2tt dataloader including data file, audio root, and target language
